prompts.prompt: Wide elevated view of a crescent outdoor feeding apron made from dark root-bound stone. Four shallow ramps descend north into low nursery hollows beneath cold blue light knots. A circular low work rail surrounds a shallow pulse basin at center. Two rows of amber fungal beads enter west. A ribbed heat braid and ash-striped translucent-plated herd animals occupy east. Thin silver-green producer mats cover shallow wet ground south. An enormous fixed black planet releases a dim red-orange sun overhead.

Medium view across a circular mineral basin on a root-stone apron. A rust-and-cream long-bodied alien hexapod with four digitigrade running legs, two small three-digit chest hands, wedge head, paired facial fans, and pale flank frame stirs mineral paste. An elderly pale silver-gray hexapod with one drooping facial fan and dark teal archive wrap rests beside translucent memory membranes. Ash-striped herd animals with glowing dorsal plates warm a ribbed braid to the east beneath cold blue tree lights.
